snippet.title: The Basment - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
THE BASEMENT — Early Demo Gameplay Trailer

Welcome to THE BASEMENT, a terrifying new horror experience where every step pulls you deeper into three escalating stages of fear.
This early demo gives you a taste of what lurks below… but only if you can interpret the hidden clues that guide your way.

🎮Play the demo on Itch.io:
👉 https://sammythedev2.itch.io/the-basement
